description: Land Acquisition - Kandanegedara. Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired for public purpose, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. It follows the statutory process for land acquisition notices under Section 7 of the Act, making it clearly a land-related matter falling under Type 4 classification.
